verdict.rationale: Gitea's own README states it provides an official CLI tool called tea, and a probe confirms official CLI documentation at gitea.com/gitea/tea, so the core of the story is delivered. missing for 10: documentation of tea's command coverage and scripting/agent-friendly features (e.g., machine-readable output, auth for automation), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
